comment: uhitm.c hmon_hitmon_misc_obj() names a cream pie that splashes a monster's face: 'A cream pie' (An(singular())) when the hero bashes with a stack of more than one, and the monster's name without a possessive when it has no face to splash (the floating eye). A human Samurai in debug mode wishes for 3 cream pies and a ring of free action (against the eye's passive paralysis), puts on the ring and wields the pies, then creates a newt and a floating eye and fights each once. The seed is the first of 7370001-7370060 where both blows land (port scan; 15 of 60 did); the fight directions are where ^G placed each monster in that game.
